about: House recipes, batch 04 (helper sA): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Porchetta-Style Pork Belly with Fennel and Rosemary
recipes.summary: Rolled pork belly packed with garlic, fennel and herbs, roasted until the crackling shatters.

items: 2 tbsp fennel seeds, toasted and crushed

steps: Score the pork skin and pat it very dry. Mix the garlic, fennel, rosemary, parsley, lemon zest, oil, chilli and 1 tablespoon of salt and spread it over the meat side.
Roll the belly up tightly and tie with string at 3cm intervals. Rub the remaining salt over the skin and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight.
Heat the oven to 240°C (220°C fan) and roast for 30 minutes, until the skin starts to blister.
Reduce to 160°C (140°C fan) and roast for 2 hours 30 minutes, until the centre reaches 80°C. Rest for 20 minutes, then slice with a serrated knife.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach at least 70°C in the centre; 80°C gives a tender, sliceable roll. Rest it before carving.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Lasagne al Forno with Slow Beef Ragu and Bechamel
recipes.summary: Layers of rich beef ragu, silky bechamel and fresh pasta baked until bubbling.
steps: Cook the onion, carrot and celery in the oil for 8 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic, brown the minces for 10 minutes, then stir in the paste and wine.
Add the tomatoes, partly cover and simmer for 1 hour 30 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick and rich and the mince is fully cooked.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the milk and cook for 8 minutes, until it thickens. Add the nutmeg and salt.
Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Layer ragu, pasta and bechamel in a dish, finishing with bechamel and the cheeses.
Bake for 40 minutes, until golden and bubbling. Rest for 15 minutes before cutting.
notes: Food safety: mince must reach 75°C right through; the lasagne should be steaming hot in the middle.
Contains gluten, dairy and egg (pasta).

recipes.title: Chicken Cacciatore with Olives and Capers
recipes.summary: Chicken braised with tomatoes, capsicum, olives and capers, hunter-style.
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil in a wide pot for 8 minutes, until golden, and lift out.
Cook the onion and capsicum for 6 minutes, until soft, then add the garlic and wine and boil for 2 minutes.
Return the chicken with the tomatoes, olives, capers and rosemary, cover and simmer for 35 minutes, until the chicken reaches 75°C.
Uncover and simmer for 5 minutes, until the sauce thickens. Scatter with parsley.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part, with clear juices.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Eggs in Purgatory
recipes.summary: Eggs poached in a spicy tomato sauce with chilli and garlic, served with crusty bread.
steps: Warm the oil in a deep frying pan and cook the garlic and chilli for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes and oregano and simmer for 12 minutes, until thick.
Make four wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 5 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks soft.
Scatter with basil and parmesan and serve with the bread.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.

recipes.title: Polenta with Mushroom Ragu
recipes.summary: Creamy polenta under a deep, garlicky mushroom and herb ragu.
steps: Cook the mushrooms in the oil in a wide pan in two batches for 8 minutes each, until deeply browned. Add the garlic and thyme for 1 minute.
Add the wine and paste and simmer for 5 minutes, until glossy.
Bring the stock to the boil, whisk in the polenta and cook over low heat for 25 minutes, stirring often, until thick and tender.
Stir the butter and cheese through the polenta and serve topped with the mushrooms and parsley.
notes: Vegetarian. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Baked Fish Livornese-Style
recipes.summary: White fish baked in a tomato, olive and caper sauce with potatoes.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Toss the potato with half the oil and roast in a baking dish for 20 minutes, until half tender.
Cook the garlic and chilli in the remaining oil for 1 minute, add the tomatoes, olives and capers and simmer for 8 minutes.
Nestle the fish into the dish, spoon over the sauce and bake for 15 minutes, until the fish turns opaque and flakes easily.
Scatter the parsley over the finished dish just before serving it, while hot.
notes: Food safety: fish is cooked when opaque and it flakes easily with a fork.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Fennel Sausages Baked with Cannellini and Rosemary
recipes.summary: Fennel sausages baked with cannellini beans, tomato and rosemary.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Cook the onion in the oil in an ovenproof pan for 5 minutes, until soft, then add the garlic.
Add the beans, tomatoes, stock and rosemary and bring to a simmer, until bubbling.
Nestle in the sausages and bake for 35 minutes, turning once, until browned and cooked through at 75°C.
Scatter the parsley over the finished dish just before serving it, while hot.
notes: Food safety: sausages must reach 75°C right through, with no pink left.
Gluten-free: check the sausage label.

recipes.title: Spinach and Ricotta Cannelloni
recipes.summary: Pasta tubes filled with ricotta and spinach, baked under tomato sauce and melted cheese.
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Mix the spinach, ricotta, egg, nutmeg and salt.
Cook the garlic in the oil for 1 minute, add the passata and simmer for 8 minutes, until slightly thick.
Spread 3/4 cup of sauce over a baking dish, spoon filling along each pasta sheet, roll up and lay seam-side down.
Pour over the rest of the sauce, top with mozzarella and bake for 35 minutes, until bubbling and golden. Scatter with basil.
notes: Food safety: the filling contains raw egg and cooks to set in the oven; the dish should be steaming hot in the centre.
Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Lemon Ricotta Griddle Cakes with Warm Honey
recipes.summary: Fluffy ricotta pancakes served with warm honey and lemon.
steps: Whisk the ricotta, egg yolks, milk and lemon zest in a bowl, then fold through the flour and baking powder.
Whisk the egg whites until they hold soft peaks and fold them in gently.
Cook spoonfuls in the buttered pan over medium heat for 2 minutes per side, until golden and puffed.
Warm the honey and drizzle over the hotcakes.
notes: Food safety: the pancakes are cooked when puffed and set through.
Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Duck Leg Confit with Puy-Style Lentils
recipes.summary: Slow-cooked duck legs with crisp skin on garlicky brown lentils.
steps: Rub the duck with the salt, thyme and half the garlic and cure in the fridge for 12 hours. Rinse and pat dry.
Heat the oven to 140°C (120°C fan). Submerge the legs in melted duck fat in a snug dish and cook for 2 hours 30 minutes, until the meat is tender and pulls from the bone.
Simmer the lentils with the vegetables, remaining garlic and stock for 25 minutes, until tender. Stir in the mustard and vinegar.
Lift out the duck, drain and crisp it, skin-side down, in a hot pan for 5 minutes, until the skin is crisp and the meat reaches 74°C.
notes: Food safety: duck legs should reach at least 74°C; confit goes well beyond that and falls from the bone.
Duck legs should reach at least 75°C; confit goes well beyond that and falls from the bone.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Provencal Fish Stew with Rouille Toast
recipes.summary: White fish and prawns in a saffron, fennel and tomato broth with garlicky rouille on toast.
steps: Cook the leek in the oil in a wide pot for 8 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic, fennel seeds, saffron and orange peel for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and stock and simmer for 20 minutes, until rich.
Mix the mayonnaise, harissa and one crushed garlic clove for the rouille, then toast the baguette until golden.

Add the fish and cook for 4 minutes, then add the prawns and mussels, cover and cook for 4 minutes, until the fish is opaque and the mussel shells have opened. Discard any mussels that stay closed and serve with rouille toast.
notes: Food safety: fish should flake and turn opaque, prawns pink and the mussel shells open; discard any that stay shut.
Contains gluten (baguette), egg, shellfish and fish.

recipes.title: Beef Bourguignon with Mashed Potato
recipes.summary: Beef braised in red wine with bacon, mushrooms and baby onions until silky.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C (140°C fan). Brown the beef in the oil in batches for 10 minutes in total, until deeply coloured, and lift out. Fry the bacon until crisp.
Cook the carrot and onion in the same pot for 6 minutes, add the garlic and paste, then the wine. Boil for 5 minutes, scraping the pot.
Return the beef with the stock, thyme and bay leaves, cover and braise for 2 hours 30 minutes, until very tender.
Add the mushrooms and pearl onions, uncover and cook for 25 minutes, until glossy.
Boil the potato for 18 minutes, until tender, drain and mash with the butter and milk. Serve with the beef.
notes: Food safety: beef chuck is safe at 75°C and tender once it shreds; the stew should be steaming hot.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Hunter-Style Chicken with Tomato and Wine
recipes.summary: Chicken braised with mushrooms, tomato, white wine and fresh tarragon.
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil in a wide pan for 8 minutes, until golden, and lift out.
Cook the mushrooms for 6 minutes, until browned, then add the shallot and garlic for 2 minutes.
Add the wine and boil for 2 minutes, then add the tomatoes and stock and return the chicken.
Cover and simmer for 30 minutes, until the chicken reaches 75°C. Stir through the butter and tarragon.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part, with clear juices.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Baked Eggs with Spinach and Cream
recipes.summary: Eggs baked in ramekins on creamy garlic spinach, French cafe-style.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Melt the butter and cook the garlic and spinach for 2 minutes, until wilted.
Divide the spinach and cream between two ramekins, crack in two eggs each and top with gruyere.
Bake for 12 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks still soft.
Scatter with chives and serve with toasted baguette.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.

recipes.title: Ham and Gruyere Crepes with Fried Egg
recipes.summary: Thin savoury crepes folded around ham, melted gruyere and a fried egg.
steps: Whisk the flour, 2 eggs, milk, melted butter and a pinch of salt into a smooth batter and rest for 15 minutes.
Cook four thin crepes in a buttered non-stick pan for 1 minute each side, until golden and lacy.
Return each crepe to the pan, add ham and gruyere and cook for 1 minute, until the cheese melts. Fold into squares.
Fry the remaining eggs in the butter for 3 minutes, until the whites are set, and top each crepe.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.

recipes.title: Paper-Baked Salmon with Fennel, Beans and Dill
recipes.summary: Salmon steamed in baking paper parcels with fennel, lemon and dill.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Tear four large sheets of baking paper.
Divide the green beans and lemon among the sheets, set a salmon fillet on each and top with dill, oil, butter and wine.
Fold and crimp the paper into sealed parcels and bake on a tray for 15 minutes, until the salmon turns opaque and flakes easily.
Open the parcels at the table, taking care with the hot steam, until the salmon is flaked and ready to eat.
notes: Food safety: salmon is cooked when opaque and flakes easily, or at 63°C.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Mushroom, Leek and Gruyere Tart
recipes.summary: A crisp puff pastry tart with sweet leeks, mushrooms and melted cheese.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Cook the leeks in the butter for 8 minutes, until soft, then add the mushrooms and thyme for 8 minutes, until browned and dry.
Lay the pastry on a lined tray, score a 2cm border and spread the creme fraiche inside it.
Top with the mushrooms and cheese and brush the border with beaten egg.
Bake for 25 minutes, until puffed and deep golden.
notes: Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Fabada-Style Chorizo and White Bean Bake
recipes.summary: White beans slowly cooked with chorizo, smoked paprika and saffron.
steps: Fry the chorizo and pork belly in a heavy pot for 8 minutes, until browned, and lift out. Cook the onion in the fat for 6 minutes, then add the garlic, paprika and saffron.
Add the tomatoes, stock, beans, bay leaves and the meats.
Cover and simmer for 55 minutes, until the beans are creamy and the pork is tender and reads 70°C.
Uncover and cook for 5 minutes, until thick. Scatter with parsley.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach 70°C inside; the stew should be steaming hot.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Pisto with Baked Eggs
recipes.summary: A Spanish vegetable stew of zucchini, capsicum and tomato with eggs baked into it.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, until soft. Add the capsicum, eggplant and zucchini and cook for 10 minutes, until golden.
Add the garlic, paprika and tomatoes and simmer for 12 minutes, until thick and soft.
Make four wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 5 minutes, until the whites are set.
Scatter the parsley over the finished dish just before serving it, while hot.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.

recipes.title: Galician-Style Octopus with Paprika Potatoes
recipes.summary: Tender octopus on soft potatoes, drizzled with olive oil and smoked paprika.
steps: Bring a large pot of water with the bay leaf to a rolling boil. Dip the octopus in and out three times until the tentacles curl, then submerge it.
Simmer gently for 1 hour 15 minutes, until a knife slips easily into the thickest part. Cool in the liquid for 15 minutes.
Boil the potato in salted water for 12 minutes, until tender, and drain.
Cut the octopus into thick slices, pile onto the potato, drizzle with oil and scatter with paprika and salt. Serve with lemon.
notes: Food safety: octopus is cooked when tender and opaque; eat it hot and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Chicken with Chorizo and Sherry
recipes.summary: Chicken thighs braised with chorizo, sherry and smoked paprika until sticky.
steps: Fry the chicken in a wide pan for 8 minutes, until golden, and lift out. Fry the chorizo for 3 minutes, until the oil runs.
Cook the onion in the chorizo oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and paprika.
Add the sherry and boil for 2 minutes, then the stock, potato and chicken. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes, until the chicken reaches 75°C and the potato is tender.
Uncover for 5 minutes, until the sauce is sticky, and scatter with parsley.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part, with clear juices.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Roast Cod with Romesco Potatoes
recipes.summary: White fish roasted over potatoes crusted with a smoky almond and capsicum romesco.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Toss the potato in 1 tablespoon of oil and roast for 25 minutes, until golden.
Blend the capsicum, almonds, garlic, paprika, vinegar and the remaining oil into a coarse romesco.
Set the fish on the potatoes and spread romesco over each piece.
Bake for 14 minutes, until the fish is opaque and flakes. Scatter with parsley.
notes: Food safety: fish is cooked when opaque and flakes with a fork.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Lamb Youvetsi with Orzo
recipes.summary: Lamb shoulder baked with tomatoes, cinnamon and orzo until the pasta is silky.
steps: Heat the oven to 170°C (150°C fan). Brown the lamb in the oil in an ovenproof pot for 8 minutes, until golden, and lift out. Cook the onion for 5 minutes, then the garlic.
Add the wine, tomatoes, stock, cinnamon, bay leaves and lamb, cover and bake for 1 hour 45 minutes, until the lamb is tender.
Stir in the orzo, add 1 cup of water if dry and bake uncovered for 25 minutes, until the orzo is tender and creamy.
Top with feta and parsley.
notes: Food safety: lamb is safe at 63°C; this braise cooks well beyond that. The dish should be steaming hot.
Contains gluten (orzo) and milk.

recipes.title: Spanakopita Pie
recipes.summary: Crisp filo pie with spinach, feta, dill and spring onion.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Mix the spinach, feta, ricotta, spring onion, herbs, eggs and nutmeg.
Brush a baking dish with oil and layer in six sheets of filo, brushing each with oil.
Spread the filling over the filo and cover with the remaining filo, brushing each sheet with oil. Score the top into squares.
Bake for 45 minutes, until deep golden and crisp, and rest for 10 minutes.
notes: Food safety: the filling has raw egg: bake until the pie is golden and set through.
Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Baked Fish with Tomato, Capers and Feta
recipes.summary: White fish baked in a Greek-style tomato sauce with capers, olives and feta.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Toss the tomatoes, onion, garlic, oil, capers, olives and oregano in a baking dish and roast for 10 minutes.
Nestle the fish into the tomatoes, squeeze over the lemon juice and crumble over the feta.
Bake for 14 minutes, until the fish is opaque and flakes easily.
Serve straight from the dish.
notes: Food safety: fish is cooked when opaque and flakes with a fork.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Greek Omelette with Feta, Tomato and Olives
recipes.summary: A fluffy omelette filled with tomato, olives, feta and oregano.
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Warm the oil in a non-stick pan, add the tomato and olives and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the eggs and cook for 3 minutes, lifting the edges, until nearly set.
Scatter over the feta, oregano and parsley, fold and cook for 1 minute, until just set.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Vegetarian. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Pork Souvlaki Plate with Lemon Rice
recipes.summary: Lemon and oregano pork skewers served on lemon rice with tomato and cucumber.
steps: Toss the pork with 2 tablespoons of oil, the juice of 1 lemon, garlic and oregano and marinate for 1 hour.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, drain and toss with the remaining lemon juice and oil.
Thread the pork onto skewers and grill for 10 minutes, turning, until browned and the centre reaches 70°C.
Serve on the rice with tomato, cucumber, onion and yoghurt.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach 70°C in the middle with no pink; rice should be refrigerated within 1 hour if there are leftovers.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Irish Beef and Stout Casserole
recipes.summary: Slow-braised beef with carrot and parsnip in a dark, malty stout gravy.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C (140°C fan). Toss the beef in the flour and brown in the oil in batches for 10 minutes in total, until deeply coloured.
Cook the onion for 6 minutes in the same pot, add the garlic and paste, then pour in the beer and boil for 3 minutes.
Return the beef with the stock, carrot, thyme and bay leaves, cover and braise for 2 hours, until tender.
Add the potato for the final 40 minutes, until soft and the sauce is thick.
notes: Food safety: beef chuck is safe at 75°C and tender once it shreds; the casserole should be steaming hot.
Contains gluten (stout, flour).

recipes.title: Beef and Swede Hand Pasties
recipes.summary: Handmade pasties of beef, potato, swede and onion in short, golden pastry.
steps: Rub the butter into the flour and salt until like breadcrumbs, then mix in the water until a dough forms. Chill for 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Mix the beef, potato, swede, onion and pepper.
Roll out six 20cm rounds, pile the filling on one half, fold over and crimp the edge firmly. Brush with beaten egg.
Bake for 20 minutes, then reduce to 160°C (140°C fan) and bake for 35 minutes, until deep golden and the beef is tender at 75°C.
notes: Food safety: the beef filling must reach 75°C throughout; check one pasty in the centre of the filling.

recipes.title: Full English Breakfast Tray
recipes.summary: Bacon, sausages, mushrooms, tomato, beans and eggs roasted and cooked together.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Roast the sausages on a tray with the oil for 15 minutes, then add the bacon, tomatoes and mushrooms.
Roast for a further 12 minutes, until the sausages are browned and cooked through at 75°C and the bacon is crisp.
Warm the beans in a small pot for 5 minutes, until hot. Fry the eggs in the butter for 3 minutes, until the whites are set.
Toast the bread until golden and serve everything together while hot.
notes: Food safety: sausages must reach 75°C with no pink; bacon should be crisp and eggs set.

recipes.title: Colcannon Cakes with Poached Eggs
recipes.summary: Crisp potato and cabbage cakes topped with poached eggs.
steps: Boil the potato for 15 minutes, until tender, drain well and mash with the butter and milk.
Cook the cabbage and spring onion in a little butter for 5 minutes, until soft, then fold into the mash with the starch and season. Shape into eight patties.
Fry the cakes in the oil for 4 minutes each side, until deep golden and crisp.
Poach the eggs in barely simmering water with the vinegar for 3 minutes, until the whites are set. Serve on the cakes.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Vegetarian. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Crumbed Sausage-Wrapped Eggs
recipes.summary: Soft-boiled eggs wrapped in seasoned sausage meat, crumbed and baked until golden.

items: 500g pork sausage, meat squeezed from skins

steps: Boil six eggs for 6 minutes, then cool in iced water and peel carefully.
Mix the sausage meat with the thyme and pepper and press around each egg to cover it fully.
Roll in the flour, dip in the beaten egg and coat in panko. Brush with oil.
Bake at 200°C (180°C fan) for 30 minutes, turning once, until deep golden and the sausage reaches 75°C.
notes: Food safety: the sausage meat must reach 75°C throughout; the centre yolk will be soft, so keep these away from children, older people and anyone pregnant unless boiled hard.

recipes.title: Lamb Hotpot with Sliced Potato Crust
recipes.summary: Lamb neck and onion braised under overlapping slices of crisp potato.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C (140°C fan). Brown the lamb in the oil in batches for 8 minutes, until golden, and place in a deep casserole.
Add the onion, carrot, stock, worcestershire sauce and thyme.
Overlap the potato slices over the top, dot with butter and season. Cover and bake for 1 hour 30 minutes, until the lamb is tender.
Uncover and bake for 30 minutes, until the potato is golden and crisp.
notes: Food safety: lamb is safe at 63°C; this braise cooks well past that and should be steaming hot.

recipes.title: Prawns and Cheesy Grits
recipes.summary: Creamy cheese grits topped with garlicky, paprika-spiced prawns and bacon.
steps: Bring the water to the boil with a pinch of salt, whisk in the polenta and cook over low heat for 20 minutes, stirring often, until thick. Stir in the butter and cheese.
Fry the bacon for 5 minutes, until crisp, and lift out.
Cook the garlic and paprika in the bacon fat for 30 seconds, add the prawns and cook for 4 minutes, until pink and opaque.
Add the lemon juice, spoon the grits into bowls and top with the prawns, bacon and spring onion.
notes: Food safety: prawns are cooked when pink, curled and opaque all the way through.

recipes.title: Sausage Gravy Biscuits
recipes.summary: Fluffy buttermilk biscuits with creamy black pepper sausage gravy.

items: 400g pork sausage, meat squeezed from skins

steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Rub the butter into the self-raising flour, mix in the buttermilk and pat out to 3cm thick.
Cut into six rounds and bake for 15 minutes, until risen and golden.
Brown the sausage meat in the oil for 8 minutes, until cooked through. Stir in the plain flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the milk.
Simmer for 6 minutes, until thick, season with the pepper and spoon over the split biscuits.
notes: Food safety: sausage meat must reach 75°C throughout, with no pink.

recipes.title: Sausage, Egg and Potato Breakfast Bake
recipes.summary: A make-ahead bake of sausage, potato, eggs and cheese.

items: 300g pork sausage, meat squeezed from skins

steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Cook the potato in boiling water for 6 minutes, until just tender, and drain.
Brown the sausage meat, onion and capsicum in the oil for 8 minutes, until the sausage is cooked through.
Spread the potato and sausage mix in a greased baking dish and top with cheese.
Whisk the eggs and milk, pour over and bake for 30 minutes, until set in the centre and golden.
notes: Food safety: sausage meat must reach 75°C; the bake is done when the egg is firmly set in the centre.
Gluten-free: check the sausage label.

recipes.title: Oven-Barbecued Beef Brisket
recipes.summary: Brisket rubbed with smoky spices and cooked low and slow until it pulls apart.
steps: Mix the paprika, sugar, garlic powder, onion powder, pepper and salt and rub it all over the brisket. Rest for 2 hours.
Heat the oven to 150°C (130°C fan). Sit the brisket in a deep tray with the stock and vinegar, cover tightly with foil and cook for 4 hours 30 minutes.
Brush with bbq sauce, uncover and cook for 30 minutes, until the surface is sticky and the centre reaches 93°C.
Rest for 30 minutes, then slice across the grain.
notes: Food safety: brisket needs to reach 93°C to be tender (it is safe at 63°C); rest before slicing.
Gluten-free: check the sauce label. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Cajun Blackened Fish with Corn Rice
recipes.summary: Spice-crusted fish seared until blackened, on rice with sweet corn.
steps: Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, adding the corn for the last 3 minutes. Drain and stir through the spring onion.
Press the cajun seasoning over the fish.
Sear the fish in the butter in a hot pan for 3 minutes per side, until blackened and opaque all the way through.
Serve on the corn rice with lime.
notes: Food safety: fish is cooked when opaque and it flakes with a fork.
Gluten-free: check the seasoning label.

recipes.title: Southwest Stuffed Sweet Potatoes
recipes.summary: Baked sweet potatoes stuffed with black beans, corn, cheese and lime crema.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Prick the sweet potatoes and bake for 50 minutes, until very soft.
Warm the beans, corn, cumin and paprika in a pan for 5 minutes, until hot.
Stir the sour cream with the lime juice.
Split the potatoes, fill with the beans, top with cheese and return to the oven for 5 minutes, until melted. Finish with crema, avocado and coriander.
notes: Vegetarian. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Macadamia and Herb-Crusted Fish
recipes.summary: Fish fillets under a golden macadamia, parsley and lemon crust.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Toss the potato in 1 tablespoon of oil and roast for 20 minutes.
Mix the macadamias, parsley, lemon zest, remaining oil and a pinch of salt.
Brush the fish with the mustard and lemon juice and press the crust on top.
Add the fish to the tray with the green beans and bake for 15 minutes, until the fish is opaque, flakes and the crust is golden.
notes: Food safety: fish is cooked when opaque and flakes with a fork.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Lamb Cutlets with Mint and Pea Smash
recipes.summary: Seared lamb cutlets with a buttery mint and pea smash and lemon.
steps: Season the cutlets and sear in the oil in a hot pan for 3 minutes each side for medium, until browned, then rest for 5 minutes.
Simmer the peas and garlic in water for 3 minutes, drain and smash roughly with the butter, mint, lemon zest and juice.
Warm the potato in the pan juices for 3 minutes, until golden.
Serve the cutlets on the pea smash.
notes: Food safety: cutlets are safe seared on all sides; 63°C is medium, 71°C well done.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Avocado, Feta and Poached Egg on Sourdough
recipes.summary: Smashed avocado and feta on sourdough with poached eggs, lemon and chilli.
steps: Mash the avocado with the feta and lemon juice and season.
Poach the eggs in barely simmering water with the vinegar for 3 minutes, until the whites are set.
Toast the sourdough until golden and spread with the avocado.
Top with the eggs, chilli, mint and oil.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Roast Pumpkin and Ricotta Breakfast Bake
recipes.summary: Roasted pumpkin and spring onion folded into a baked ricotta and egg custard.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Roast the pumpkin with the oil for 25 minutes, until tender and browned.
Whisk the ricotta, eggs, milk and half the spring onion until smooth and season.
Scatter the pumpkin in a greased baking dish, pour over the egg mix and scatter with feta.
Bake for 25 minutes, until set in the centre and golden. Top with the remaining spring onion and chives.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Vegetarian. Gluten-free.
